_comment: E-0350: 16-bit operands read by hand, keyed by the instruction's bank:address. 'bank' names the ROM bank a pointer operand points into (tools/disasm_all.py then writes the label there, or Label + $offset inside a labelled table); 'lb' writes a register pair holding two separate bytes as `lb rr, $HI, $LO`; 'expr' replaces the number with an expression of the same value (the build checks every byte). 'label' names a label the entry creates; 'why' is the reading behind each entry (C1).
